steps.text: Combine barley flour and rock salt. Gradually add warm water; knead into a soft, smooth dough. Cover and rest 15–20 min.
Divide into equal balls. Dust with flour and roll into thin, round rotis.
Cook on a medium-hot tawa. Apply ghee; cook until bubbles form, then flip. Apply ghee on second side; press gently with spatula until puffed and cooked through.
Serve hot with curry, dal, or chutney.
Soak de-husked black gram 6–8 hr or overnight; grind to a smooth paste.
Make soft wheat dough with rock salt and water; cover and rest 15–20 min.
Portion the paste into balls for stuffing. Flatten each dough ball, place paste in centre, seal edges.
Dust and roll thin. Cook on a medium tawa with ghee or sesame oil until golden brown spots appear on both sides. Serve hot with ghee.
Soak black gram 6–8 hr; grind to a smooth paste.
Knead wheat flour with water into a soft dough.
Make stuffing balls from paste. Flatten dough, fill, seal, and apply a little oil; roll thin and round.
Heat ghee in a deep pan. Slide each puri in gently; press lightly with a slotted spoon to puff. Fry until both sides are golden brown. Drain on paper and serve hot.
Mix flour and rock salt; gradually add water and knead into a soft dough. Cover and rest 15–20 min.
Roll into thin, round rotis. Cook on a medium tawa with ghee, flipping when bubbles appear. Press gently to puff.
Serve hot with curry, dal, or chutney.
Add milk gradually to flour; knead into a soft dough. Cover and rest 5–10 min.
Roll into thin, round rotis. Cook on a medium tawa with ghee on both sides, pressing to puff.

Mix flour, rock salt, and 3–4 tsp ghee. Add water gradually and knead into a firm dough. Rest 15–20 min.
Divide into medium balls. Cook using one of the following methods:
Cool slightly. Dip in melted ghee or pour ghee generously over each. Serve with dal.
Add water gradually; knead into a soft, smooth dough. Cover and rest 5–10 min.
Roll into thin, round rotis. Cook on a medium tawa with ghee on both sides, pressing to puff.

Shape into small round discs (2–3 inches). Steam until fully cooked. Remove from heat and serve.
Wash black gram; soak 4–6 hr. Drain and grind with minimal water into a smooth, thick batter. Beat until light and fluffy.
Mix in rock salt, ginger paste, and hingu.
Heat oil over medium flame. Wet hands; take batter, shape into vada with a hole in the centre. Slide gently into hot oil; deep fry until golden and crisp on both sides.
Drain on paper. Serve with a side dish of your choice.
Combine flour, pumpkin paste, rock salt, ginger paste, hingu, black pepper, fenugreek, and cumin. Add water gradually to form a smooth, thick, fluffy batter.
Heat oil over medium flame. Shape into vada with a hole; deep fry until golden and crisp. Drain and serve.
Mix both flours with cumin, hingu, and black pepper. Add 2–3 tsp ghee and rub in. Add water gradually; knead into a soft, smooth dough.
Divide; roll each ball thin and round (applying a little ghee/oil to prevent sticking).
Deep fry in hot ghee until puffed and golden on both sides. Drain and serve hot.
Mix all three flours with cumin, hingu, and black pepper. Add 2–3 tsp ghee; mix. Add water gradually; knead into a soft, smooth dough.
Divide; roll thin and round (apply a little oil to prevent sticking).
Deep fry in hot ghee until puffed and golden on both sides. Drain and serve.
Knead flour with water and ghee into a smooth dough.
Shape dough into small elongated tubes (3–5 cm).
Mix clove powder, pepper, camphor, and rock sugar into a filling powder. Stuff tubes; press and seal both ends.
Deep fry in ghee until golden and crispy.
**Make chena:** Boil milk; add lemon juice gradually while stirring until milk curdles. Strain through muslin, wash with clean water, hang 20–30 min to drain.
**Dough:** Add rice flour to chena; knead 8–10 min until smooth and crack-free.
**Shape:** Divide into 3–4 balls (25–30 g each). Roll smooth.
**First fry:** Deep fry in medium-hot ghee until light golden. Cool slightly.
**Stuff:** Make a small cavity in each; fill with reserved chena mixed with a little sugar and camphor. Seal.
**Second fry:** Fry again until golden brown. Drain.
**Syrup:** Boil 20 g sugar in 40 ml water to 1–2 thread consistency; add a pinch of camphor.
**Soak:** Immerse dumplings in warm syrup for 10–15 min. Serve warm.
Soak cowpeas/soybeans 4 hr; pressure cook until soft. Add pumpkin pieces; cook further with a glass of water.
Mix ragi flour into 1 cup water to a smooth paste (no lumps).
Add ragi paste to the cooked pumpkin; boil, stirring. Add jaggery syrup, coconut, and ghee; mix well.
Heat a lightly greased pan; pour a ladle of batter, spread gently. Cook until edges set; flip and cook until golden brown.
